pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī bahussutā hoti bhāṇikā visāradā paṭṭā dhammiṃ kathaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.3: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo sītakāle mahagghaṃ kambalaṃ pārupitvā yena thullanandā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.5: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.7: sace me tvaṃ mahārāja dātukāmosi imaṃ kambalaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.8: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā kambalaṃ datvā uṭṭhāyāsanā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma rājānaṃ kambalaṃ viññāpessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.12: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.13: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.14: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā rājānaṃ kambalaṃ viññāpessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī rājānaṃ kambalaṃ viññāpessatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī rājānaṃ kambalaṃ viññāpessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:1.21.1: “garupāpuraṇaṃ pana bhikkhuniyā cetāpentiyā catukkaṃsaparamaṃ cetāpetabbaṃ, tato ce uttariṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:2.1.10: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np11:2.1.13: “idaṃ me ayye garupāpuraṇaṃ atirekacatukkaṃsaparamaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajāmīti” …pe…
